title: bid9 Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the bid9 adapter

channelId.description: bid9 channel ID, sent as imp.tagid and as the tagid URL parameter

publisherId.description: bid9 publisher ID, used when site.publisher.id or app.publisher.id is empty

bidFloor.description: Static floor, used when the impression has no bidfloor

bidFloorCur.description: Currency of bidFloor, defaults to USD
